gold.text: Users can filter animals for adoption based on species, age range, size, and compatibility (whether they are suitable for children/other pets).
Users can sort the list of matched pets by relevance or publication time.
Users can click to enter the pet's details page to view multiple photos, detailed personality descriptions, and health status of the pet.

pred.text: Pet profile content is relevant and complete

gold.text: Users can click on pets they are interested in and save them to their personal favorites list for quick retrieval later.
Users can fill out and send an adoption consultation application through the form at the bottom of the pet's details page.
When filters combine multiple criteria (such as "small + kitten + suitable for cats"), the search results must strictly match the tags in the backend database.
Before submitting the adoption consultation form, the required fields (such as name and contact information) must be validated to prevent sending empty information or incorrectly formatted requests.

pred.text: Inquiry form rejects empty required fields

gold.text: The system must prevent users from sending multiple inquiry forms for the same pet within a short period of time.
When a user clicks the "Save" button, the icon should immediately change visually (e.g., from hollow to solid).
After filtering and sorting operations are triggered, the list area should display a loading status and provide a smooth visual transition when the results are returned.

pred.text: Result list responds immediately to filter/sort changes

gold.text: The pet photo viewer should support swiping left and right or clicking on thumbnails to switch between them.
Automatically jump to the pet information area when viewing pet details.
Pet cards and detail pages must clearly indicate the name and approximate location of the shelter to which the pet belongs.
The "Compatibility" label must be displayed prominently as an icon or highlighted text.
The pet information displayed on the favorites list page must be consistent with the data on the search results page and the details page.
All pet photos shown must be related to the specific pet shown (placeholders or generic images may not be used in place of the actual pet).

pred.text: Pet photos are present and relevant
